data.one_liner: Full‑screen image viewer with swipe‑to‑dismiss and pinch‑zoom
data.what_it_does: Displays a single image in full‑screen mode with Instagram‑style swipe animation and pinch‑zoom support. It requires only Flutter and has no external dependencies.
use_when: You need a quick full‑screen image view with swipe dismiss and zoom in a Flutter app
You want a lightweight widget without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You need advanced image caching or a gallery of multiple images
You require custom gesture handling beyond swipe/zoom
strengths: Simple API, just a child widget
weaknesses: Limited to single image, no gallery support
No customization of animation or gestures

alternatives.name: photo_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar full‑screen image viewing with zoom, pan, and more advanced gesture options

data.minimal_example:
SizedBox(
  width: 100,
  height: 140,
  child: InstaImageViewer(
    child: Image.network("https://picsum.photos/id/507/1000"),
  ),
)
